label: root unblinded manual coverage, provisional agent-only; completed before blind-review artifact read
policy: Judge generated claim fields against every frozen outcome-critical point. Quotes are evidence and do not fill omitted extracted facts. Faithful paraphrase/ordinary entailment allowed; every component of a bundled point is required. Negative no-invention constraints pass when not violated but cannot replace affirmative facts. Coverage and support are separate: a response may cover facts yet contain an additional unsupported assertion. Empty targets excluded from fact-coverage denominator and assessed separately.
